India's Supreme Court Directs Performance Audit and Establishment of National Legal Academy

The Indian Supreme Court has directed the Bar Council of India (BCI) to conduct a performance audit and establish a National Legal Academy for continued legal education of advocates, emphasizing the importance of independence in both the judiciary and the legal profession.
